merchant/30149.htm.text: Merchant Creamees: Welcome, friend! Ah, the herbs smell wonderful, don't they? My young friend Herbiel is making a new secret potion. Why don't you take a look? Perhaps you will find something you need...

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30149-pk.htm.text: Trader Creamees: Leave this place before I call upon the spirits of the forest to harm you.

Q00160_NerupasRequest/30149-01.html.text: Trader Creamees: The item that Unoren ordered? Oh, you mean the Nightshade Leaf. I went through a bit of trouble to get this... I stored it in the warehouse because it's such a rare item... If you take this ticket and go see Julia at the warehouse, she'll give you the Nightshade Leaf.

Q00160_NerupasRequest/30149-02.html.text: Trader Creamees: Did you get the Nightshade Leaf from Julia? Not yet? Go to the warehouse and show Julia the ticket I gave you. Then she will give you the Nightshade Leaf that I stored there.
when: state STARTED; has items 1028; lacks items 1027

Q00160_NerupasRequest/30149-03.html.text: Trader Creamees: I see you've gotten the Nightshade Leaf. Please deliver it the Unoren at the weapon shop.

Q00164_BloodFiend/30149-00.htm.text: Trader Creamees: Personally, I don't want to work with Dark Elves like you. If I think of what I lost to the race of darkness, I want to draw my sword and cut off your head this very moment. You may think me rude to say so, but that is my honest feeling. (Not available for Dark Elven characters.)

Q00164_BloodFiend/30149-06.html.text: Trader Creamees: The skull of the Blood Fiend Kirunak... if only this would wash away the sins of the past... Thank you. I'll compensate you as promised. And... I must make a confession. It was not the Dark Elven Mystics, but I that called forth Kirunak from hell during the last siege of the fortre…

Q00164_BloodFiend/30149-05.html.text: Trader Creamees: In order to make our revenge complete, you must slay Kirunak , the leader of the Drevanuls. Please hurry and kill this monster. May the brilliance of Einhasad's will protect you. Do not hesitate to raise high the sword of revenge!

Q00164_BloodFiend/30149-04.htm.text: Trader Creamees: The Drevanul devils that came through the gates of hell during the last battle still live in the ruins of the Underground Fortress.
